questions.q: How much did the poor man get for a year of service?
questions.e: The master took out one coin: “Here, that is your wage.”

questions.q: How did the servant test whether he had earned the coin?
o: He threw it in a fast stream: if it floated, he had earned it
He buried it in the ground
questions.e: He threw it in the water: if it didn't sink, he had earned it.

questions.q: In which year did the coin finally float?
questions.e: After the third year the coin floated on the water.

questions.q: What did the servant ask his master to do before the sea voyage?
o: Buy something with his coin in the foreign land
questions.e: He asked the master to buy something with his coin in the other kingdom.

questions.q: What did the master buy with the coin by the sea?
o: A cat that children were about to drown
questions.e: He gave the children the coin and got the cat.

questions.q: How did the cat help in the foreign city?
o: It taught the townspeople to fish
It caught the mice and rats, and the ship was filled with silver and gold in return
It saved a rich man from a fire
questions.e: The cat caught the mice and rats, and the host filled the ship with silver and gold.

questions.q: What did the servant finally get?
o: All the riches from the ship and his master's daughter as a wife
questions.e: The master gave him everything he brought on the ship and his daughter too.
